research_subject: Diligent Robotics, Inc.（整公司；被 Serve Robotics 收购后仍独立运营）
entity_note: 扩展批次（第四批之一）。研究主体为 Diligent Robotics 整公司；收购方为 Serve Robotics，交易于 2026 年一季度完成。

evidence.claim: Serve Robotics 于 2026-01-20 宣布收购 Diligent Robotics，交易对价 2900 万美元的 Serve 普通股，另加与未来业绩里程碑挂钩的 530 万美元；交易预计 2026 年一季度完成；Diligent 将继续由联合创始人兼 CEO Andrea Thomaz 领导、继续在奥斯汀运营且不迁往加州；该交易把 Serve 从配送机器人扩展到医疗机器人，Moxi 将成为其新医疗业务线首批部署的机器人
evidence.quote: Serve Robotics is acquiring Diligent in a deal valued at $29 million in Serve common stock, with an additional $5.3 million tied to future performance milestones. The transaction is expected to close in the first quarter of 2026. … Serve said Tuesday that Diligent will continue operating under the leadership of co-founder and CEO Andrea Thomaz. … Diligent employs about 215 people at its offices on East Cesar Chavez Street, and Serve said it has no plans to c…
evidence.quote_locator: 正文交易条款段与运营安排段
evidence.source_title: Austin-based robotics company to be acquired in $29 million stock deal
evidence.publisher: Austin American-Statesman（经 Yahoo Finance 转载）
evidence.note: 收购对价含里程碑部分，按原文分开保留；员工数与被收购方名称来自同一报道，属报道口径。第三渠道另记 3430 万美元协议对价与已完成交割 2500 万美元，存在口径差异，本文件按本页原文记录并另注冲突。

evidence.claim: 同一报道记述：Diligent Robotics 成立于奥斯汀（2017 年），旗舰机器人 Moxi 由 Nvidia AI 芯片驱动，协助护士与药房人员运送实验室样本等物资；Moxi 已在美国 30 家以上医院部署；收购前数月曾在 Nvidia GTC 大会上发布新机器人设计
evidence.quote: Diligent Robotics, founded in Austin in 2017, designs robots to work alongside hospital staff in health care settings. Its flagship robot, Moxi, is powered by Nvidia Corp. AI chips and assists nurses and pharmacy staff by transporting lab s… … Austin-based Diligent Robotics has deployed its Moxi robot in more than 30 hospitals nationwide. … The acquisition comes just months after Diligent unveiled a new robot design at Nvidia's GTC AI conference in October.
evidence.source_title: Austin-based robotics company to be acquired in $29 million stock deal
evidence.publisher: Austin American-Statesman（经 Yahoo Finance 转载）
evidence.note: 30 家以上医院为报道口径；GTC 发布月份原文为 October（未给年份），按原文保留。

evidence.claim: Serve Robotics 8-K：2026-01-27 完成收购 Diligent。交割对价为总值 2900 万美元普通股，该金额包括最高 530 万美元或有对价；另有净债务调整现金约 1900 万美元。不能把 2900 万与 530 万相加。
evidence.quote: On January 27, 2026, Serve Robotics Inc. completed the previously announced acquisition of Diligent Robotics, Inc. … aggregate consideration … aggregate value of $29.0 million … (which amount includes potential earnout amount of $5.3 million which may be earned upon the achievement of certain milestones
evidence.source_title: Serve Robotics Inc. Form 8-K（收购 Diligent 完成）
evidence.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / Serve Robotics
evidence.note: 2900 万美元口径包括最高 530 万美元或有对价。媒体“另加 530 万”为误读。后续 8-K/A 预估购买价约 2570 万美元属交割会计计量，与协议总额分开。
